verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI ships a GitHub Actions integration (PR reviews, issue triage, @gemini-cli mentions) and documents MCP-based extensibility examples referencing @github and @slack commands, showing GitHub-triggered agent tasks are real. However, GitLab and Linear integrations are not evidenced at all, and Slack support is only shown as an example MCP query rather than a documented official trigger/integration. missing for 10: official GitLab integration, official Linear integration, a documented first-party Slack trigger/app (not just an example MCP command).
